title: teucrium webbianum subsp. pugionifolium
intro: Teucrium webbianum subsp. pugionifolium, commonly known as Webb's germander, is a plant species of the genus Teucrium. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Webb's germander include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including iridoids, diterpenes, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation, hepatoprotection, and antiparasitic activities.
